description: End the session: close the profile's browser cleanly (its cookies and tabs are saved). With delete=true the profile is also moved to trash, where the person can restore it. With purge=true it is moved to trash and then deleted for good: use that for throwaway profiles you created for this task (an agent key may purge only profiles it created). For a throwaway task, browz_session_open (ephemeral) and browz_session_close wipe the profile for you.

delete.description: Also move the profile to trash (restorable)

purge.description: Also delete the profile for good: trash, then purge. Cannot be undone. An agent key may purge only profiles it created

name: browz_session_end
title: End session
